actions.name: According To My Design
actions.rulesText: Rebel player rolls 1 fewer red die and 2 fewer black dice for the first round of air and ground combat.

actions.name: Blindside
actions.rulesText: Opponent cannot send leaders from his leader pool to oppose this leader's mission.

actions.name: Boba Fett Where
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in an Imperial system — Rebels cannot attempt missions or use action cards here.

actions.name: Brilliant Administrator
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in an Imperial system and immediately build with it.

actions.name: Catch Them By Surprise
actions.rulesText: Move a fleet immediately (i.e. in the assignment phase, before the Rebels have a chance to move).

actions.name: Fully Operational
actions.rulesText: If either a Death Star or Death Star Under Construction is in this system, destroy 1 Rebel ship of your choice in the system.

actions.name: Good Intel
actions.rulesText: Rebel player must keep tactic cards faceup.

actions.name: It Is Your Destiny
actions.rulesText: Use during a mission after a leader is rescued. Capture 1 leader who attempted the mission.

actions.name: Keep Them From Escaping
actions.rulesText: Rebel units cannot retreat.

actions.name: Local Rumors
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in any system with an Imperial unit. Rebel player must state whether the Rebel base is in that region.

actions.name: More Dangerous Than You Realize
actions.rulesText: Draw either 3 space tactic or 3 ground tactic cards.

actions.name: Proceeding As Planned
actions.rulesText: Search the project deck for 1 project and assign this leader to it.

actions.name: Public Support
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in an Imperial system without Rebel ground units — gain 3 Stormtroopers. Janus does not stop units from moving out of the system this turn.

actions.name: Ready For Action
actions.rulesText: Take a leader from the leader pool, place in combat, and get him back at end of fight.

actions.name: Scouting Mission
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in any system. Then move up to 4 TIE Fighters from any system(s) to this system, ignoring transport restrictions and adjacency. If there are Rebel ships in this system, resolve a combat.

actions.name: Target The Generator
actions.rulesText: Destroy 1 structure in the system.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in a system to destroy up to 3 health of Imperial ground units.

actions.name: An Old Friend
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in Bespin or Kashyyyk to recruit Lando or Chewbacca.

actions.name: Human Cyborg Relations
actions.rulesText: C-3PO ring — discard to automatically succeed at a diplomacy mission after failure.

actions.name: Independent Operation
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in a subjugated system in the assignment phase. All Imperial ground units there must be moved to one Imperial system of their choice.

actions.name: Its A Trap
actions.rulesText: During the first round of combat, your opponent cannot play space tactic cards.

actions.name: Noble Sacrifice
actions.rulesText: Use when this leader becomes captured. He is eliminated, and you gain 1 reputation.

actions.name: One In A Million
actions.rulesText: Use during a combat or mission — instead of rolling up to two dice, place them on the table showing results of your choice. Can be used to roll an automatic success with the "Death Star Plans" objective.

actions.name: Our Most Desperate Hour
actions.rulesText: Search the assignment deck for a card and put Leia on it.

actions.name: Point Blank Assault
actions.rulesText: All units in the system have -1 health, to a minimum of 1.

actions.name: Rebel Planning
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in the "Rebel Base" space to draw 1 objective card.

actions.name: Resourceful Astromech
actions.rulesText: R2-D2 ring — discard to turn 1 opponent's die to the blank side.

actions.name: Son Of Skywalker
actions.rulesText: After a successful mission, search the mission deck for "Seek Yoda" or "Daring Rescue" card.

actions.name: Start The Evacuation
actions.rulesText: Move units from the Rebel Base to any system without Imperial units during the assignment phase.

actions.name: Target The Star Destroyers
actions.rulesText: During the space battle of each combat round, treat up to 2 of your black hits as red hits.

actions.name: Temporary Alliance
actions.rulesText: Place this leader in a neutral system to add that system's units to the build queue.

actions.name: The Milleninium Falcon
actions.rulesText: Add the "Millennium Falcon" ring — automatically rescue 1 captured leader in a system after a successful mission there.

actions.name: Undercover
actions.rulesText: When the opponent attempts a mission, move this leader from any system to that system to help oppose it.

actions.name: Wookie Guardian
actions.rulesText: Use when your opponent attempts a Spec Ops mission — it automatically fails.
